items.title: CME Group (CME) Stock Trades At A Premium To Fair Value
items.summary: CME Group stock has delivered a strong 5 year run, yet the current valuation checks suggest the shares now trade at a premium, with the Excess Returns intrinsic value estimate pointing to a price roughly 9% above where that model would flag clear value. The 82.6% total return over 5 years highlights solid shareholder gains, which can limit how much cushion is left if expectations ease. items.title: CME Group (CME) Hits Record Henry Hub Interest As August Volumes Stay Strong
items.summary: CME Group (NasdaqGS:CME) reported record open interest in its Henry Hub Natural Gas futures, tied to heightened geopolitical and seasonal energy market activity. The company recorded exceptionally strong August trading volumes across multiple asset classes, including U.S. Treasury, metals, and energy contracts.
